Traffic Control & Bandwidth Shaping (Section 8):
• Priority 1: Network Control (Tunnels, DNS, NTP, RADIUS, Logs) -> 2M/2M gtd
• Priority 2: Logistics (Receiving, scanning, code sheets) -> 44M/11M gtd
• Priority 3: Drone Ground Station (Missions, multipart uploads) -> 5M down / 20M up gtd (burst 61.5M up)
• Priority 4: Staff Workstations (Center management, reporting) -> 28M/7M gtd
• Priority 5: Non-operational capped pool (Transport, Guests) -> 30M down max (Transport 20M, Guest 10M)
